import requests
import json

PARAM_DOCS = {
    "q": "Search text",
    "page": "Page number (1-based)",
    "limit": "Number of results per page (max 100)"
}

EXAMPLE_PARAMS = {
    "q": "python",
    "page": 2
}

ALGOLIA_URL = "https://uj5wyc0l7x-dsn.algolia.net/1/indexes/Item_dev/query"
HEADERS = {
    "x-algolia-agent": "Algolia for JavaScript (4.13.1); Browser (lite)",
    "x-algolia-api-key": "28f0e1ec37a5e792e6845e67da5f20dd",
    "x-algolia-application-id": "UJ5WYC0L7X",
    "content-type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"
}

def run(
    q: str = "ai",
    page: int = 1,
    limit: int = 30
) -> list:
    """
    Search Hacker News stories.
    Returns a list of dicts with: name (title), points, url.
    """
    # Algolia expects 0-based page
    payload = {
        "query": q,
        "analyticsTags": ["web"],
        "page": max(page - 1, 0),
        "hitsPerPage": limit,
        "minWordSizefor1Typo": 4,
        "minWordSizefor2Typos": 8,
        "advancedSyntax": True,
        "ignorePlurals": False,
        "clickAnalytics": True,
        "minProximity": 7,
        "numericFilters": [],
        "tagFilters": [["story"], []],
        "typoTolerance": True,
        "queryType": "prefixNone",
        "restrictSearchableAttributes": [
            "title", "comment_text", "url", "story_text", "author"
        ],
        "getRankingInfo": True
    }
    resp = requests.post(
        ALGOLIA_URL,
        headers=HEADERS,
        data=json.dumps(payload),
        timeout=10
    )
    if not resp.ok:
        raise RuntimeError(f"HTTP {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}")
    data = resp.json()
    results = []
    for hit in data.get("hits", []):
        # Only include items with a title (stories)
        title = hit.get("title")
        if not title:
            continue
        results.append({
            "name": title,
            "points": hit.get("points", 0),
            "url": hit.get("url")
        })
    return results[:limit]

if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(json.dumps(run(), indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
